QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (the default in `mbedtls_config.h:208`), `include/mbedtls/platform.h:167` makes `mbedtls_calloc` expand straight to `calloc`, and `:166` does the same for `mbedtls_free`. Nothing is indirected.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that in the default build (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off) the macros expand directly to `calloc` and `free`, with no indirection.
